entries.text:
Successfully built CompCert C verified compiler version 3.13.1 from source for x86_64-linux. The compiler is now available at `/tmp/CompCert/ccomp` (a symlink to `/tmp/CompCert/bin/ccomp`). 

Steps completed:
1. Created directory `/tmp/CompCert` and downloaded CompCert 3.13.1 source
2. Installed build dependencies: OCaml, Coq 8.18, Menhir, and libmenhir-ocaml-dev
3. Configured for x86_64-linux target with prefix `/tmp/CompCert`, using `-ignore-coq-version` flag due to Coq 8.18 being newer than supported
4. Patched `flocq/Calc/Bracket.v` to use `Z_div_mod_eq_full` instead of `Z_div_mod_eq` for compatibility with Coq 8.18
5. Built the compiler (`make ccomp`) successfully
6. Built runtime library (`make runtime`)
7. Installed to `/tmp/CompCert` directory (`make install`)
8. Created symlink `/tmp/CompCert/ccomp` for direct invocation

The compiler is fully functional and can compile C programs as verified by a test compilation.
